'''Club Mahindra''' is an [[India|Indian]] hospitality company established on 20 September 1996. It is a subsidiary of the [[Mahindra Group]] and operates a [[timeshare]] network of resorts across India and internationally.<ref>{{cite web |last=Merwin |first=Radhika |date=30 August 2015 |title=Should you sign up for timeshares? |url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/portfolio/beyond-stocks/should-you-sign-up-for-time-shares/article7596676.ece |publisher=The Hindu Business Line}}</ref>

==Resorts==
[[File:Club Mahindra, Munnar - panoramio.jpg|thumb|Club Mahindra resort in [[Munnar]]]]
As of 2025, Club Mahindra operates over 140 resorts globally.<ref>{{cite news|title=Mahindra Holidays & Resorts India Ltd.|newspaper=Business Standard India |url=http://www.business-standard.com/company/mahindra-holiday-18268/information/company-history|url-status=live|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170103165024/http://www.business-standard.com/company/mahindra-holiday-18268/information/company-history|archivedate=2017-01-03}}</ref> In India, it has more than 80 resorts in diverse landscapes such as the [[Himalayas]], beaches, hill stations, backwaters, deserts, and forests.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Explore 140+ Resorts in India and Abroad with Club Mahindra |url=https://www.clubmahindra.com/resorts |access-date=2025-01-31 |website=Club Mahindra}}</ref>

==Acquisitions==
In 2014, MHRIL acquired an 18.8% stake in European company Holiday Club Resorts Oy.<ref>{{cite web|title=Mahindra Holidays to hike stake in Holiday Club Resorts to 88%|work=dna |date=10 June 2015 |url=http://www.dnaindia.com/money/report-mahindra-holidays-to-hike-stake-in-holiday-club-resorts-to-88-2094114|url-status=live|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20171222060848/http://www.dnaindia.com/money/report-mahindra-holidays-to-hike-stake-in-holiday-club-resorts-to-88-2094114|archivedate=2017-12-22}}</ref> In June 2014, MHRIL acquired [[Finland]]-based Holiday Club Resorts for ₹600 crore.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/Mahindra-buys-Finnish-company-Holiday-Club-for-Rs-600-crore/articleshow/37987719.cms|title=Mahindra buys Finnish company Holiday Club for Rs 600 crore |website=The Times of India |date=8 July 2014 |url-status=live|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170204163501/http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/Mahindra-buys-Finnish-company-Holiday-Club-for-Rs-600-crore/articleshow/37987719.cms|archivedate=2017-02-04}}</ref> In 2015, MHRIL raised its stake in Holiday Club Resorts Oy to 88%.

In 2016, it acquired a 12% stake in Nreach Online Services.<ref>{{cite news|title=Mahindra Holidays to acquire 12% stake in Nreach|newspaper=Business Standard India |date=October 2016 |url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/mahindra-holidays-to-acquire-12-stake-in-nreach-116100100663_1.html|url-status=live|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20171222053139/http://www.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/mahindra-holidays-to-acquire-12-stake-in-nreach-116100100663_1.html|archivedate=2017-12-22|agency=Press Trust of India }}</ref>

In 2017, the company increased its stake in Holiday Club Resorts Oy by 6.33%, bringing its total holding to 91.94%.<ref>{{cite web|title=Mahindra Holidays buys additional 6.33% stake in Holiday Club Resorts|date=11 January 2017 |url=http://www.zeebiz.com/companies/news-mahindra-holidays-buys-additional-633-stake-in-holiday-club-resorts-10608|url-status=live|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20171222052114/http://www.zeebiz.com/companies/news-mahindra-holidays-buys-additional-633-stake-in-holiday-club-resorts-10608|archivedate=2017-12-22}}</ref> In 2017, MHRIL partnered with the Ideal Group of Companies to expand operations in [[Sri Lanka]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Ideal Group forays into hospitality and leisure industry Introduces best-value Mahindra Holidays in unique resorts|url=http://island.lk/index.php?page_cat=article-details&page=article-details&code_title=174107|url-status=live|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20171222051518/http://island.lk/index.php?page_cat=article-details&page=article-details&code_title=174107|archivedate=2017-12-22}}</ref>

In 2018, Suha Travel & Tours W.L.L became the official distribution partner in [[Bahrain]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Club Mahindra expands to Bahrain |url=https://www.facebook.com/clubmahindra/photos/club-mahindra-now-enters-the-kingdom-of-bahrain-we-welcome-suha-travel-tours-abo/10155979642348303/ |website=Facebook |url-status=dead}}{{deadlink|date=September 2023}}</ref>
